qcom_hot_flagship.name: Snapdragon 888 / 8 Gen 1
qcom_hot_flagship.description: Lahaina (SM8350) and Waipio (SM8450) throttle hard under sustained load: no performance governor, no GPU power lock.

qcom_gen2_gen3.name: Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 / 8 Gen 3
qcom_gen2_gen3.description: Kalama (SM8550) and Pineapple (SM8650) push well past sustainable thermal budget under the performance governor and with GPU rails pinned; both cause rapid thermal throttle and fan-less designs hit skin-temp limits in under a minute.

qcom_kona.name: Snapdragon 865 / 870
qcom_kona.description: Kona (SM8250) and its overclocked derivative (SM8250-AC / 870) sustain high temps under the performance governor on most thin-body designs.

qcom_parrot.name: Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 / 6 Gen 1 (Parrot)
qcom_parrot.description: Parrot phones (Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G, POCO X6, ...) are passively cooled: clocks pinned at max and rails held on averaged 77 °C CPU in games.

qcom_legacy_mid.name: Legacy Snapdragon mid-range (2016-2019)
qcom_legacy_mid.description: SDM 4xx/6xx series and MSM8xxx chips run kernel 4.9/4.14/4.19 vendor trees whose kgsl drivers do not reliably support force_bus_on and force_rail_on; pinning those can cause kernel oops on some vendor builds.

exynos_hot.name: Exynos 2100 / 2200
exynos_hot.description: Exynos 2100 (S5E9840) and 2200 (S5E9925) overheat with the performance governor.

exynos_2300.name: Exynos 2300
exynos_2300.description: S5E9935 (Exynos 2300) runs significantly hotter than its predecessor under sustained performance governor usage.

mtk_dimensity_9000.name: Dimensity 9000 / 9000+
mtk_dimensity_9000.description: MT6983 runs its big cores far past the phone's sustained power budget: no performance governor.

mtk_dimensity_9200_plus.name: Dimensity 9200 / 9200+ / 9300
mtk_dimensity_9200_plus.description: MT6985 (Dimensity 9200/9200+) and MT6989 (Dimensity 9300) exceed the sustained power envelope under the performance governor on thin-and-light designs.

mtk_dimensity_8000.name: Dimensity 8000 / 8100 / 8200
mtk_dimensity_8000.description: MT6895 (Dimensity 8000/8100) and MT6896 (Dimensity 8200) throttle under the performance governor on mid-range thin-body phones; GPU power efficiency drops sharply when clocks are pinned.

unisoc_budget.name: Unisoc T-series
unisoc_budget.description: Unisoc T606/T616/T618/T760/T770/T820 have limited sustained thermal headroom and exhibit unstable behaviour under the performance governor on budget thin-body designs.
